entries.name: array-statistics
entries.description: Creates a numeric array and calculates its mean and standard deviation.
entries.definition: Creates a numeric array and calculates its mean and standard deviation.
entries.template:
import numpy as np

values = np.array({values}, dtype=float)
mean = values.mean()
standard_deviation = values.std()
